title: Load-slice integrity verification rejects existing native stores: repair refuses with 239 invalid work records and ordinary open is refused
outcome: Load-slice integrity verification rejects existing native stores: repair refuses with 239 invalid work records and ordinary open is refused
acceptance: on a copy of the pre-load-slice live store, engram doctor --repair-projections on master succeeds and reports healthy with zero invalid work records; ordinary open then succeeds; a storage test seeds a native-only store, runs the restored-projection verification, and asserts zero findings

completion.summary: Fixed native-store repair false positives by comparing verified canonical JSON; retained typed validation and added invalid-label diagnostics, native-only repair and drift/rollback regressions.
